# Attribute support by session type

<!-- Generated by tests/VisaCs.Tests/AttributeTableGenerator.cs. Regenerate on Linux with:
     VISACS_GENERATE_DOCS=$PWD/docs/attributes.md dotnet test tests/VisaCs.Tests --filter AttributeTableGenerator -->

This table is generated from live sessions opened against the simulators, so it lists exactly what
`GetAttribute`/`SetAttribute` accept. **RW** = read/write, **R** = read-only, blank = not supported
(`VI_ERROR_NSUP_ATTR`). **Type** is the type of the value `GetAttribute` returns; `SetAttribute` converts
other numeric types, and enum names, to it. Most attributes also have a typed property on the session class,
named in the IntelliSense documentation of the `VisaAttribute` member.

| Attribute | Enum member | Type | TCPIP INSTR (VXI-11) | TCPIP INSTR (HiSLIP) | TCPIP SOCKET | VICP INSTR | USB INSTR | USB RAW | GPIB INSTR | GPIB INTFC | ASRL INSTR | PXI INSTR |

## Events by session type

| Session | Events |
|---|---|
| TCPIP INSTR (VXI-11) | `ServiceRequest` |
| TCPIP INSTR (HiSLIP) | `ServiceRequest` |
| TCPIP SOCKET | none |
| VICP INSTR | `ServiceRequest` |
| USB INSTR | `ServiceRequest`, `UsbInterrupt` |
| USB RAW | `UsbInterrupt` |
| GPIB INSTR | `ServiceRequest` |
| GPIB INTFC | `ServiceRequest` |
| ASRL INSTR | none |
| PXI INSTR | none |

Columns: TCPIP INSTR (VXI-11) = `TcpipVxi11Session`, TCPIP INSTR (HiSLIP) = `TcpipHislipSession`, TCPIP SOCKET = `TcpipSocketSession`, VICP INSTR = `VicpSession`, USB INSTR = `UsbSession`, USB RAW = `UsbRawSession`, GPIB INSTR = `GpibSession`, GPIB INTFC = `GpibInterfaceSession`, ASRL INSTR = `SerialSession`, PXI INSTR = `PxiSession`.
